title: Enter the Warren
body: Every worker is a creature, and food is the power grid. Drag the map to look around. Tap + or − to zoom.

title: Stabilize the Food Grid
body: Read Food Grid: keep Production above Upkeep. Tap Farm, then open floor. If food pressure appears and Idle is 0, tap − beside Miner, then + beside Carrier or Cook in Jobs.

title: Close the Living Factory Loop
body: Tap the existing Mine in the warren to read its rate. Place a Blacksmith, tap + beside Smith in Jobs, then tap the Blacksmith and tap Iron Pickaxe. The miner equips it on its own and the Mine speeds up.

title: Secure the Warren
body: Deliver 50 ore and hold 100 food in Objective. Before a raid, free a worker with − if Idle is 0, then tap + beside Guard in Jobs. This secures the warren and ends onboarding; next, forge 20 ingots and raise the Shrine.

title: Awaken the Worm
body: Keep the Worm Shrine running: its panel shows food and ingot offerings, reserves, and blockers. Feed the Colossal Worm sleeping below. This tutorial completes when the worm awakens.
